Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Floret's inference requirements. Quick recap so we have the same page: 

- Key problems you raised: inconsistent latency at 95th percentile, rising token costs on bursty traffic, data isolation requirements for patient-related PII.
- How Redwood maps to that: hosted API for fast POC, Dedicated pools (GPU isolation) for predictable throughput, and Private VPC for regulated workloads. We also highlighted automatic KV-prefix caching and model routing to control unit cost on conversational workloads.

Next practical steps I suggested on the call:
1) A 30-min technical scoping call with Marissa (SE) to go over model sizing and latency targets.
2) A short 2-week pilot on a single inference route (we can set quotas) to validate end-to-end latency + cost.

One quick favor: would you mind replying with where this sits on Floret's priority list right now? A one-line answer like: "Now / Next quarter / Not a fit" is perfect — that'll help me coordinate resources.

I've attached a 1-page discovery recap (discovery-recap.pdf) and included a link to my calendar below if you want to lock the scoping call now.

Thanks — I appreciate it.
